flow.flow_name: Upload & Extract Stock Statement to Google Sheets
flow.description: Uploads an unstructured stock statement (image, pdf, excel, word, or text), uses Google Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash) to extract structured inventory data, and writes the result to a Google Sheet named after the input file.
